table.name: TLGNC_ORDER_REP
table.description: Stores additional information about a repair/maintenance order. For other 'special' orders (e.g. plain transportation order) the usual data in order/order_item is sufficient, but for repair/maintenance additional data is required. The order has delivery distribution type 'REP', hence the table name. The maintenance types (tlgnr_maint_type_bs/tx) treat 'repair' just as another form of 'maintenance'. The difference mainly is, that 'maint' orders are created based on some schedule (planned), but 'repair' orders are created when something gets broken. When this happens, 'maintenance' works is often executed on the same occasion, therefore repair and maintenance are all handled in just one additional table.

column.name: ORDER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_order. Unique. The order for which special info is stored. Must be of delivery distribution type 'REP' for maintenance/rep.

column.name: EMAIL_SEND_FLAG
column.description: True, if a notification e-mail should be sent to various recipients when an order is transmitted to rail company.

column.name: EMAIL_LAST_SENT_DAT
column.description: Date and Time, when e-mail was sent to the recipients in to/cc/bcc. If another e-mail is sent later, this timestamp is overwritten.

column.name: EMAIL_TO_ADRESSES
column.description: E-mail addresses (separated by comma) used as TO-recipients in the notification e-mail. Initial TO (and for automatically generated orders): value is taken from tlgnc_shipto.order_conf_email_address.

column.name: EMAIL_CC_ADRESSES
column.description: E-mail addresses (separated by comma) used as CC-recipients in the notification e-mail. Initial CC (and for automatically generated orders): value is taken from tlgnc_wagon_keeper.email_addresses IF wagon_keeper.maint_email_flag = true.

column.name: EMAIL_BCC_ADRESSES
column.description: E-mail addresses (separated by comma) used as BCC-recipients in the notification e-mail. Initial BCC (and for automatically generated orders): value of rail admin (see config). The recipient from mail.bcc (see tlgnr_config) are always added as BCC in addition and are not stored/editable in this field.

column.name: EMAIL_ADDITIONAL_REMARKS
column.description: Remarks about the special/maintenance/repair order. This remark is externally visible as it is included in the notificiation e-mails. Initial value (and for automatically generated orders): tlgnc_shipto.note_delivery + tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.note_delivery for the matching material (if defined).

column.name: DOCUMENTATION_ACCEPT_FLAG
column.description: 1=true if the documentation has been accepted.

column.name: OFFER_DESIRED_FLAG
column.description: 1=true if an offer is desired, i.e. if the repair plant should first do an estimate of the repair costs before performing the repair work. For auto generated orders: 0/false.

column.name: OFFER_ACCEPT_DAT
column.description: Date when offer was accepted.

column.name: OFFER_ACCEPT_FLAG
column.description: 1=true if the offer has been accepted.

column.name: OFFER_AMOUNT
column.description: Amount of the offer.

column.name: OFFER_CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. The currency in which offer_amount is expressed.

column.name: INVOICE_DAT
column.description: Date of the invoice.

column.name: INVOICE_NO
column.description: Number of the invoice.

column.name: INVOICE_AMOUNT
column.description: Amount of the invoice.

column.name: INVOICE_CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. The currency in which invoice_amount is expressed.

column.name: INVOICE_PAID_FLAG
column.description: 1=true if the invoice has been paid. This is independent of the order.order_status_cd, i.e. an order can be finished but the invoice is not yet paid.

column.name: REMARKS_INTERNAL
column.description: Internal remarks about the special/maintenance/repair order. This remark is for Crh employees only.

column.name: OFFER_REMARKS
column.description: Internal remarks about the special/maintenance/repair order. This remark is for Crh employees only.

column.name: DOCUMENTATION_REMARKS
column.description: Internal remarks about the special/maintenance/repair order. This remark is for Crh employees only.

column.name: ENTER_PLANT_DAT
column.description: The date when the wagon entered the plant (repairing work has been started on it).

column.name: LEAVE_PLANT_DAT
column.description: The date when the wagon leaved the plant (done with the repair work).
